const bearPick=document.getElementById('bearPick'); const orderPreview=document.getElementById('orderPreview'); let order=null,state=null,station='base',selectedBear=null,currentCustomer=null,spriteTimer=null,customerBag=[]; // Shared with Finishing Station: count only genuine, completed perfect orders. const v=Number(localStorage.getItem(BAO_PERFECT_ORDERS_KEY));return Number.isFinite(v)?Math.max(0,Math.floor(v)):0;}catch(_){return 0} } function recordCafePerfectOrder(){ const const LEFT_FACING_CUSTOMERS=new Set(['Gentleman Duck']); function isHumanoidCustomer(customer){return !!customer && !NON_HUMANOID_CUSTOMERS.has(customer.name)} function shouldFlipCustomer(customer){return !!customer && LEFT_FACING_CUSTOMERS.has(customer.name)} function tuneCustomerIcon(img){ if(!img) return; const isSmall = !!(img.naturalWidth && img.naturalHeight && img.naturalHeight <= img.naturalWidth + 8); img.classList.toggle('smallSpriteIcon', isSmall); } function applyCustomerPose(prefix){ const img=document.getElementById(prefix+'CustomerSprite'); wrap.classList.toggle('nonHumanoidCustomer',!humanoid); } function applyCustomerFacing(prefix){ const img=document.getElementById(prefix+'CustomerSprite'); if(!img) return; a[Math.floor(Math.random()*a.length)]} function refillCustomerBag(){ customerBag=[...CUSTOMER_SPRITES]; for(let i=customerBag.length-1;i>0;i--){ const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)); [customerBag[i],customerBag[j]]=[customerBag[j],customerBag[i]]; } } function nextCustomer(){ if(!customerBag.length) refillCustomerBag(); return customerBag.pop(); } function decode64(s){const Toppings':list.map(id=>TOPPING_NAMES[id]||id).join(' + ')} function toppingSpeech(list){ if(!list||!list.length)return 'no toppings'; const names=list.map(id=>TOPPING_NAMES[id]||id); const paint=()=>{ customerEl.src=second&&cust.idle2?cust.idle2:cust.idle1; bearEl.src=second&&bear.idle2?bear.idle2:bear.idle1; }; paint(); spriteTimer=setInterval(()=>{second=!second;paint()},520); } const liquid=doc.getElementById('liquid'); if(!stage||!liquid)return; stage.querySelectorAll('.cafeActualToppings').forEach(node=>node.remove()); const toppings=Array.isArray(chosen)?chosen:[]; const ordinary=toppings.filter(id=>!['whipped','cheese','cookie'].includes(id)); const layer=(name,z,mask=false)=>{ const el=doc.createElement('div'); el.className='cafeActualToppings '+name; el.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:0;top:12%;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1/1;z-index:'+z+';pointer-events:none;overflow:visible;';
